description: Given the plans you own, how much of each is used, and the task type, returns which plan to use now, a fallback, when each limit resets (from vendor-stated windows), a rationale, a suggested weekly rotation, and source links. Same logic as https://planlimits.app/router/. Unknowns are labeled estimate / not published. Plan ids: claude-pro, claude-max-5x, claude-max-20x, codex-free, codex-go, codex-plus, codex-pro, cursor-free, cursor-plus, cursor-premium, cursor-super, cursor-ultra, copilot-free, copilot-pro, copilot-pro-plus, copilot-max, antigravity-individual-free, antigravity-google-ai-pro, antigravity-google-ai-ultra, windsurf-free, windsurf-pro, windsurf-max.

state.description: fine = Fine / plenty left; low = Running low (~80% of the main limit used); session_hit = Hit the short (session/daily) limit; exhausted = Hit the main (weekly/monthly) limit; weekly_hit / monthly_hit = aliases of exhausted. Unknown values are rejected.

task.description: refactor = Big refactor / long agent run; everyday = Everyday edits; quick = Quick questions
